Welcome to the official YouTube channel for A Place to Call Home, Foxtel’s internationally recognised and critically acclaimed Logie award-winning drama. Subscribe to A Place to Call Home to fully immerse yourself in life at Inverness; relive some of your favourite moments, catch behind the scenes action, watch exclusive interviews with all the cast and keep up-to-date with latest news and clips from the series.

A PLACE TO CALL HOME The Final Season is brought to life by the Award winning actresses Marta Dusseldorp and Noni Hazlehurst, along with Brett Climo, Abby Earl, Craig Hall, Sara Wiseman, Tim Draxl, Frankie J Holden, Deborah Kennedy, Arianwen Parkes-Lockwood and David Berry.
